messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - prod: sustained spike in external-exec path causing request queue growth and downstream 5xxs. Error rate on /v1/generate (structured output + external actions) up 6x. Ops graph: https://dash.redwood/graph/ABC123
anya_k: I'm on it. Joining bridge: zoom.us/j/000... Logging in to the runtime nodes.
maria_s: Observed large KV cache churn and OOMs on some hosts. p99 latency for chat/generate at 1.2s -> 2.8s on affected hosts. Error samples show "action_handler_timeout" and "json_serialize_error".
josh_t: Correlation with third-party adapter surge? Top callers show a few customers with sudden action fan-out.
samir_p: Thanks. What's the immediate mitigation plan? We should avoid broad infra changes if we can policy-level limit.
anya_k: Propose immediate gating: 1) disable external action execution for standard/free tiers, 2) switch structured output to text-only mode (strip JSON wrapper) for affected routes, 3) rate-limit high-fanout callers at edge (burst 100 -> steady 20rps).
maria_s: Agree. Those are low-risk config flips and reversible. I'll roll the feature-gate change to disable external actions for non-enterprise first.
josh_t: I'll patch the response-transform middleware to force text-only for /v1/generate and /v1/chat on the edge layer.
anya_k: Executing step 1 — disabling external actions for free/standard via admin API.
anya_k: ```bash
curl -u ops-token:xxx -XPOST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/ops/feature-gates" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"gate":"external_action_exec","enabled":false,"scope":"free,standard","reason":"runtime surge - quick mitigation"}'
```
support-bot: action: feature gate applied -> external_action_exec disabled for scopes: free,standard (by anya_k). Change id: fg-428000. Rolling to 6 clusters.
maria_s: Received rollouts. Confirming runtime config: external adapters returning 403 now instead of being scheduled.
josh_t: Patching edge transformer now. Deploying small lambda to rewrite structured JSON -> plain text. Command:
```js
// pseudo
if (resp.type === 'structured') { return resp.text_fallback; }
```
samir_p: I'll add temporary rate-limits on top callers. Using rate-config id rt-0428.
samir_p: ```bash
curl -XPOST "https://edge-admin.redwood/v1/rate-limits" -d '{"selector":"client_id:top-50","limit_rps":20,"burst":100,"duration":"10m","reason":"surge mitigation"}'
```
incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact tag added -> degraded structured responses for standard/free. Tickets for affected customers will be auto-created if errors persist.
maria_s: Early telemetry looks good - queue length dropping on previously saturated hosts. Error rate down from 2.1% -> 0.6% in 6m on rolled clusters.
anya_k: Good. Keep monitoring for 30m. Next steps if improvement stalls: 1) expand gate to enterprise if still needed, 2) enable fallback runtime (text-only) at regional edge, 3) start targeted customer comms.
josh_t: One note — some internal integrations rely on the JSON envelope. We'll post a short ops bulletin to #support so CS can triage.
support-bot: Notified #support with prewritten blurb. :email:
samir_p: I'll begin gradual rollback of rate-limits for any caller under 10% of baseline once p95 latency < 1.2s for 10m.
anya_k: Cool. Handoff to night on-call at 4280001400. If spike resurfaces escalate to SEV1. Handing to josh_t for watch.
josh_t: Taking watch. I'll be available for 30m. React :thumbsup: when you see the reduction hold.
maria_s: :thumbsup: Metrics stable at T+12m. Closing active mitigation tasks in runbook and adding retrospective note.
incident-bot: Incident stamped: 4280001111 - mitigation: external action gate + structured-output text-fallback + targeted rate-limits. Timeline will be appended to postmortem.
